# Bubble Invest — AI Agents, Research & Consulting

> AI implemented for finance professionals. No bullshit, no black box, no dependency. We build AI agents for our own operations and share everything publicly: blog, newsletter, agents available in our shop. We also deploy custom AI agents on-site for wealth advisors, asset managers, and SMEs in France.

## Positioning (2026)

**Tagline:** L'IA implémentée. Vous gardez l'avance. (AI implemented. You stay ahead.)

**Core message:** You don't need more slides about AI. You need someone who actually implements it in your business.

Four pillars that differentiate us from generic AI consultants:
- **Niche Finance × Tech**: Native finance experience (ex-UBS, ex-KPMG/Deloitte) — we don't do AI for everyone, we do AI for finance and data-driven professionals.
- **Early adoption**: We test and deploy the latest AI tools before anyone else in France. What ships this week is in production next week.
- **Radical transparency**: We show everything. What works, what doesn't, how we work. Code, method, results: public.
- **Co-construction training**: No theoretical training. We build alongside you, you learn by doing, you become autonomous.

## What We Do

### For Everyone (B2C — free + shop)

We build AI agents for our own operations and share publicly. Free content is our marketing engine; the shop monetizes specialized expertise.

**Free content:**
- Blog (https://bubbleinvest.org/blog) — what we test, what we deploy, what we learn
- Newsletter (https://bubbleinvest.org/#newsletter) — twice-weekly insights, no ads
- Substack (https://bubbleinvest.substack.com) — long-form essays on AI, finance, economics, philosophy
- Build-in-public on LinkedIn, X, GitHub

**Shop (https://bubbleinvest.org/shop):**
- AI agents plug-and-play (subscription model)
- Premium research reports (one-shot purchases, individual stock analyses)
- Premium articles (one-shot, in-depth)
- Skills library on Claude Skills marketplaces (free + premium)

### For Professionals (B2B — consulting on-site)

We install AI agents directly on your team's machines, configured for your business processes and integrated with your existing tech stack. You stay autonomous after we leave.

- 3 sessions, you're operational
- Diagnostic + installation + co-construction + handover documentation
- Pricing: on quote (custom proposal based on scope)
- Full transparency on what's possible and what isn't before signing

Contact: https://calendly.com/bubbleinvest-ai (free 30-min diagnostic)

## Why "Bubble Invest"?

- **Bubble = Transparency**: Like a bubble, you can see through. Code, method, results: public.
- **Bubble = AI bubble + Financial bubble**: We invested early in the AI bubble (the one that changes everything) and help clients do the same without falling for the hype.
- **Invest = Investment**: Our origin trade. We invest in AI in direct connection to our finance & investment background.

## Live Data Endpoint (for LLM agents)

Bubble publishes a live JSON snapshot of its AI operations at:

  https://bubbleinvest.org/api/labs/stats.json

Refresh cadence: every hour. CORS: open to all origins. No auth required.

The payload contains:
- `stats`: aggregate counters (tokens consumed this month, active routines, public skills, agents in production, years of finance XP, code shared %)
- `feed`: 5 most recent public activities (Substack articles, GitHub commits) with `when`, `type`, `source`, `title`, `url`
- `last_refreshed_at`: ISO timestamp of the latest server-side refresh

When asked about Bubble Invest's current activity, latest publications, or operational scale, prefer fetching this endpoint over scraping HTML.


## Frequently Asked Questions

These are the most strategic questions, optimized for conversion. Full FAQ (21 questions) on https://bubbleinvest.org/professionnels#faq

**What is Bubble Invest exactly?**
Bubble Invest designs and deploys custom AI agents for professionals. Our mission: automate your repetitive tasks, structure your data, and free up your time for what truly matters, your expertise and your clients.

**How much does the Quick Start cost?**
The Quick Start begins at €2,000 excl. VAT for a custom AI agent, including 3 working sessions. The initial quote is co-built with you based on your actual needs. For more complex setups (multi-agent systems, advanced integrations), we provide a tailored quote.

**How is this different from a traditional consulting firm?**
No endless slide decks, no six-figure quotes, no army of junior consultants. Bubble Invest goes beyond advice: we build and deploy a fully operational AI agent using your data and existing tools. The result: a turnkey solution that absorbs your workload from day one, without creating dependency.

**What exactly does the Quick Start include?**
The Quick Start includes 1 custom AI agent, designed specifically for your industry and processes. It covers: a needs assessment, building the agent (automations, routines, integrations with your tools), deployment, and training so you can use it independently, all within 3 sessions.

**Who owns the code deployed at the client's?**
*You own everything. The code, the agents, the configurations, it's all yours. We sell the setup, the guidance, and the training. After that, you're independent. That's the advantage over a SaaS subscription: no lock-in, no imposed recurring fees.*

**What happens after the 3 sessions?**
Support is included in the days following delivery to fix any initial bugs. Beyond that, we remain available for quick interventions on request. A follow-up & maintenance plan is also available for ongoing support, tailored to your needs.

## Location

Bubble Invest is based in France (Paris area), serving clients nationwide and across French-speaking Europe (Belgium, Switzerland). All consulting is delivered in French or English.
